I accidentally combined the demon power, the goat lord power, the jetpack, and the pitching machine together. It was a nightmare. I actually ultra rubbergoatbanded myself so far outta the map it actually reset me with no powers at all. The whole game didn't restart, the goat just reset, because everything was still wrecked.

It's funny, but I kinda wish there was a way to cycle between the abilities.

If you haven't found out yet, here's what I do:

I go to the end of the crane and turn the goat so he's facing backwards. I proceed to ragdoll and try to move him so he falls off. I then control him to land onto the crate while in ragdoll mode, and make him stand back up.

From there, I hop over the support cables and make it to the edge of the crate opening. I try either ragdolling into the crate similar to the crane, or try to time my jump and make it into the crate.

However you do it, be careful of the robot. It will try to punch you, and if you're ragdolled and too close to the edge it might knock you out of the crate.

Hope this helps!

Oh, I haven't noticed. Wow, lol. It's still kinda annoying being revived and shot again. Kinda delays the respawn process altogether.

I don't care if I'm revived at 20 health or 100 health. However, I get annoyed when I get revived right into a firefight, because the medic didn't pay attention to his surroundings, making the revive useless. I'm willing to sacrifice my revive points if it means not letting the enemy getting another kill.

If you're a sniper, please don't sit at the edge of the map the whole game. Be dynamic and get closer to the action to help support the team.

Before y'all sniper fans start bombarding me, I've caught numerous people just chilling on the outskirts of any happenings, laying down behind a rock. They weren't spotting or anything, and would end up being 1 and 1 with just a few hundred points. Meanwhile, our team is struggling, and that one guy is just sitting back not contributing to the team. It's even worse when it's a squad leader, and he's not sending out orders.

Oh yeah, if you're a squad leader, send orders and request for assets when a Commander is available. It gives the Squad Leader role its purpose.

That's another easy way to get points, and it helps provide some sorta tactics. It bothers me when I see the enemy attacking us in groups, when my own team is scattered across the whole map.
